title: Day 7: First Match (LIVE)
ctaComment: my guess for the legend is… 👀

chunks.text: Day seven. And we just hit one hundred followers! Thank you... for real. Next goal: two hundred fifty.
You voted B... number ten. But for one hundred followers, you get both. Ten on the home kit... and seven on the away kit.
First practice with the squad. Close control. Little touches. Head up. Ball glued to my feet.
Then finishing. Plant foot next to the ball... laces through it... follow through.
Then coach dropped a surprise. A friendly. Tonight. Against Eastside... the best team in the league.
One-nil down. I heard Dez in my head... never waste a touch.
Minute seventy-eight. One touch... cut inside...
Card check. Dribbling: twenty-five to thirty. Shooting: twenty-two to twenty-eight. Overall... twenty-seven!
Tomorrow... the special match. Someone legendary is coming. Drop your guesses.

chunks.title: STRIKER
chunks.text: Option A: I start as a striker.

chunks.title: WINGER
chunks.text: Option B: I start on the wing.
Comment A or B. Day eight.
